name: Aluva · Periyar River
note: Aluva sits where the Periyar splits around Manappuram; the town was largely submerged in the August 2018 floods.
disclaimer: Real road, bridge and river geometry from OpenStreetMap with Copernicus DEM terrain. Incidents, reports and flood depths are simulated. Not an operational system.

source.model_elevation: 1.0 + 0.50 x relief above the valley floor (5th percentile), mapped into the simulator's water-level frame
source.population: WorldPop 2018 (100 m) tile totals, split across junctions by OSM building count
source.bridge_clearance: lower approach elevation (DEM, model frame) + 0.6 m deck, clipped to 2.4-6.0
source.road_speed: ground-unit speed factor by OSM highway class (trunk 1.4 ... residential 0.75)
source.shelter_capacity: S1-S3 set by the scenario; S4+ indicative by facility type
